title: Bitcoin's $87k rejection: $82–83k held
dek: Coinbase price, Farside ETF flows, and OKX positioning through the first support test after the $87.4k sweep.
thesis: The $87.4k door failed. The $82–83k door held. The tail is not confirmed.
stakes: ETF inflows stayed positive and slowed. Next evidence is a reclaim of $86k — or a close through $82k, then $80k.
subscribeHook: When $82k fails — or $86k is reclaimed — the letter updates the sequence. Charts stay free here; the call moves by email.
sourceNote: Issue 27 charts use Coinbase Exchange UTC candles, Farside Investors US-session ETF flows, and OKX public BTC-USDT perpetual open-interest/funding data. The 23 September ETF row is the completed Farside print (+$346.9M), not Issue 26's preliminary +$32.4M. Weekend blanks are not zeroes. Educational scenario research; no leverage.

briefs.headline: The first named support door held
briefs.lede: A $82,709 low on 24 September is a test, not acceptance through $82k.
briefs.bodyHtml:
Fact. Coinbase's 24 September candle traded to $82,709 and closed at $84,385. The 25 September candle closed at $84,093 after a $85,250 high.

Read. $87.4k has behaved like a sweep so far. The next doors remain $86k on the upside and $82k, then $80k, on the downside.

briefs.headline: The sign stayed green; the impulse faded
briefs.lede: Seven reported inflow sessions, including a completed +$346.9M on 23 September, while price stalled under $86k.
briefs.bodyHtml:
Fact. Farside recorded +$999.0M, +$714.7M, +$346.9M, +$190.7M, and +$134.5M from 21–25 September. Issue 26's 23 September row was a preliminary +$32.4M.

Read. ETF absorption divergence is a research watch: vehicle demand up on a cumulative basis, price response down. It is not automatic distribution.

briefs.headline: OI kept coming out after the flush
briefs.lede: Venue open interest fell from $2.66B to $2.40B; funding cooled toward neutral, including brief negative prints.
briefs.bodyHtml:
Fact. OKX BTC-USDT perpetual OI was $2.66B on 20 September and $2.40B on 25 September. Average 24 September funding was 0.0010% per eight hours.

Read. This is a venue-specific reset. Residual fuel remains above the 15 September baseline.
